title: General Therapeutic Approaches
content: This document outlines various therapeutic approaches for mental health conditions such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Exposure Therapy, and Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR). It includes general guidelines and strategies for treating conditions like anxiety, depression, and PTSD, without referencing any specific patient cases.

title: Consultation Notes - 02/15/2022
